title: Compassion
competency: Explain compassion and its importance, and act compassionately.

keywords.def: Understanding another person's feelings and wanting to act for their good.

en.text: Compassion is understanding another person's feelings and wanting to act for their good. We show it by encouraging, listening and understanding, even people we disagree with. With more compassion there would be far less hunger, conflict, homelessness and unhappiness.

screens.title: Figure 1.5: a sad friend
screens.ask: Your classmate is crying after bad news. What shows compassion?
opts: Sit with her, listen and comfort her
screens.after: Compassion means understanding her feelings and acting to help, as in Figure 1.5.

screens.title: Compassion
paras: Compassion is understanding another person's feelings, with a desire to act on their behalf.
It is caring about others' well-being, essential for the common good.
Friends may need encouragement, the gift of being listened to, or simply to be understood.

screens.title: Case study: the two sisters
steps: The younger sister met a poor old woman at the spring who asked for water.
She kindly gave her a drink.
The older sister met a beautiful, thirsty princess.
She refused and told her to fetch her own water.
The younger sister showed compassion; the older did not.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Understanding another person's feelings and wanting to act for their good.

screens.why: She gave water to the poor old woman.

screens.text: Which is NOT an example of showing compassion, according to the review?
screens.why: Giving things is linked to generosity; compassion is understanding and acting on feelings.
screens.clue: Which one is about things, not feelings?

screens.text: Your brother is shouting because he had a bad day. A compassionate reply is
opts: Stay calm and ask gently what is wrong
Tell your parents to punish him
screens.ans: Stay calm and ask gently what is wrong
screens.why: Compassion means understanding the other's feelings and caring for them.

screens.text: A classmate you often argue with is sick for a week. What would a compassionate student do?
opts: Bring her the class notes and wish her well
screens.ans: Bring her the class notes and wish her well
screens.why: Compassionate people care even for those they disagree with.
screens.clue: Does compassion depend on being friends?
